title: Cerebus Jaka’s Story 22 - Comic Book - Jun #135 Aardvark-Vanaheim 1990
descriptionText:
This comic book is a single issue of Cerebus #22, published by Aardvark-Vanaheim in June 1990. It features the character Morgana and is part of the Cerebus series, which was created by Dave Sim and Gerhard. The comic book is in English and intended for a general audience. It is uncertified and unsigned. 

This issue is a great addition to any comic book collection and is perfect for fans of the Cerebus series. The comic book is in good condition and has been well-preserved. It will be shipped securely to ensure its safe arrival. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this classic comic book.
